parsed.rationale: The cluster pairs `MockStructuredAnalytics.StoppedEventProxy__Playback` (located in `Shared/Analytics/Sources/AnalyticsTesting/MockStructuredAnalytics.swift`) against the production type `PlaybackStoppedEvent` (located in `Shared/Playback/Sources/PlaybackCore/Analytics/PlaybackAnalytics.swift`). The file path `AnalyticsTesting/MockStructuredAnalytics.swift` and the `Mock` prefix on the containing type are canonical mock-fixture markers. Per the decision rules, any cluster where at least one participating record is a mock fixture must be treated as intentional duplication — the proxy type exists precisely to mirror the shape of the production event for test-double purposes, and lifting shared structure would couple production analytics semantics to test infrastructure. No structural refactor is warranted.
